title: Can Coding Agents Solve Repository-Level Issues with Rendered Code? An Exploratory Study of Visual Representations
title_zh: 编码智能体能用渲染代码解决仓库级问题吗？视觉表示的探索性研究
abstract_en: Visual modality has recently been explored as a way to compress textual tokens, including rendering code as images for static code understanding. We study whether this representation can serve as operational context for agentic coding, where an agent must navigate repositories, edit source files, and verify executable patches. Using SWE-bench Verified, we evaluate rendered code in repository-level repair workflows and introduce controlled agent settings to separate unguided repository exploration from more structured repair stages. Our results show a mixed picture. Rendered code consistently reduces prompt-token cost, but the savings do not increase linearly with the nominal visual compression ratio. It largely preserves end-to-end repair accuracy, but does not overcome the performance limits of the underlying model or agent architecture, and can become unstable under aggressive compression. Further analysis suggests that visual code is most useful when raw source reading is a major bottleneck; once repository localization is structured, much of the remaining cost comes from patch--test trial-and-error, where visual compression has limited leverage. Overall, our study positions rendered code as a viable but conditional compression mechanism for realistic coding agents.
abstract_zh: 本文研究将代码渲染为图像的视觉表示，是否能作为 agentic coding 场景中的有效操作上下文。作者在 SWE-bench Verified 上评估 rendered code 在仓库级修复流程中的表现，并设计受控智能体设置，以区分无引导的仓库探索与更结构化的修复阶段。结果显示：rendered code 能稳定降低 prompt token 成本，但节省幅度并不随名义视觉压缩率线性增长；它基本保持端到端修复准确率，但无法突破底层模型或智能体架构的性能上限，并且在激进压缩下可能变得不稳定。进一步分析表明，当原始源码阅读是主要瓶颈时，视觉代码最有价值；一旦仓库定位被结构化，后续主要成本来自 patch-test 反复试错，此时视觉压缩的收益有限。总体而言，rendered code 是一种可行但有条件适用的真实编码智能体压缩机制。
key_points_zh: 研究问题：探索 rendered code（将代码渲染为图像）能否作为编码智能体在仓库级 bug 修复中的上下文表示，而不仅是静态代码理解的压缩手段。
实验设置：基于 SWE-bench Verified，评估 rendered code 在 repository-level repair workflow 中的效果，并通过受控 agent 设置区分无引导仓库探索与结构化修复阶段。
主要发现：rendered code 能持续降低 prompt token 成本，但实际节省不与视觉压缩率线性对应；整体修复准确率大体保持，但无法弥补模型或 agent 架构本身的能力限制。
局限性：在过度压缩时，视觉代码表示会出现不稳定；当修复流程进入 patch-test 试错阶段后，主要成本不再是源码阅读，视觉压缩的边际收益明显下降。
结论：rendered code 是一种可用于真实编码智能体的条件性压缩机制，尤其适合源码阅读成本高、仓库定位尚未结构化的场景。

llm_assessment.comment: An in-scope coding-agent study of rendered-code context compression, but its contribution is exploratory and not a new harness or training loop.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项属于范围内的代码智能体渲染代码上下文压缩研究，但贡献偏探索性，并非新的框架或训练闭环。
